thermal_time.note: The Tomonaga-Schrödinger flow U(l) = exp(-i ∫ H_eff dl) is exactly the Tomita-Takesaki modular automorphism group of the Gibbs thermal state w.r.t. H_eff. Thermal time identifies physical time with this modular flow; redshift implements the Tolman law, Unruh/Hawking temperatures appear as the KMS temperatures of the appropriate accelerated/eternal observers. The Cocycle Radon-Nikodym theorem provides a state-independent outer automorphism (absolute modular time), while thermal time is state/perspective-dependent.
